title: ag-cli

description.en: Dispatch tasks to local Antigravity sessions from any CLI bot
description.zh: 让任意 CLI 机器人把任务派发给本机 Antigravity 会话

subject: Brushed-brass pneumatic message capsule with a blue enamel band and a stitched leather pull strap

logo.sourcePath: Hexly-generated first-identity candidate; source adoption pending

palette.source: Authored presentation background.base; not a product UI token

source.description: Dispatch tasks to local Antigravity sessions from any CLI bot

goal.en: Let external CLI bots dispatch tasks to local Antigravity conversations, wait on events and collect structured results and artifacts, with a protocol modelled on herdr-core.
goal.zh: 让外部 CLI 机器人向本机 Antigravity 会话派发任务、按事件等待并回收结构化结果与产物，协议设计对齐 herdr-core。

role.en: CLI runtime, state machine and compiled binary
role.zh: CLI 运行时、状态机与编译二进制

role.en: Read-only conversation facts and its own state database
role.zh: 只读会话事实与自有状态库

role.en: Unit, integration and end-to-end suites with 95% coverage
role.zh: 单元、集成与端到端测试，覆盖率 95%

subject.en: Brushed-brass pneumatic capsule with a blue enamel band and a leather strap
subject.zh: 带蓝色珐琅环与皮拉带的拉丝黄铜气动信筒

description.en: One sealed capsule at a product-photography angle with its strap, inset inside the rounded presentation. Its contact shadow is independent.
description.zh: 一只密封信筒连同皮拉带以产品摄影角度完整呈现，整体内缩于圆角展示之内，接触阴影独立保存。

description.en: Brushed brass carries the identity; a narrow blue enamel band and a stitched saddle-leather strap are the crafted accents. Real thickness and machined seams keep it credible.
description.zh: 拉丝黄铜构成主体，窄蓝色珐琅环与缝线马鞍皮拉带是工艺点缀，真实厚度与机加工接缝保持可信。

description.en: A cool grey-blue paper field holds sparse paired conduit lines and flange ticks. None of it enters transparent UI marks.
description.zh: 冷灰蓝纸面上只有稀疏的成对管道线与法兰刻线，均不进入透明界面标记。

palette.source: Native ag-cli raw PNG, sRGB pixel (640, 900)
Native ag-cli raw PNG, sRGB pixel (450, 1100)
Native ag-cli raw PNG, sRGB pixel (1700, 1000)

sizeNote.en: The capsule silhouette and blue band remain at 32 px; the strap stitching and brushed grain recede at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素仍可辨认信筒轮廓与蓝环；16 像素时缝线与拉丝纹理减弱。

description.en: Shallow paired conduit channels, rounded elbows and small flange rings press a quiet dispatch route into matte paper.
description.zh: 浅浅的成对管道槽、圆弧弯头与小法兰环压在哑光纸面上，勾勒出安静的派发路径。
